title: Improved a lot of elements based on feedback received since my last post
author: Secret_Slide_1357
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1qhebyv/video/cvhs152yyceg1/player

\-Bullets have been dramatically improved.  
\-Sprites are more stable.  
\-Added more background parallax layers.  
\-Added smoke trails and dusk vfx.  
\-Fixed blood splatter  
\-Fixed health asset.  
\-Revamped top left UI  
\-Revamped mission complete menu  
\-Added visual auras based on killchain stauts  
\-Helicopter extraction

There's probably more but you get the idea.

Any feature or anything you think I should add?

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: This is a strong iteration pass, and the feedback clearly translated into meaningful gameplay and visual improvements. Very nice!

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body: Consider 8-direction bullets instead of homing. Currently all bullets seem to home in on enemies and the player. If they go in 8 directions (horizontal, vertical, or 45' diagonal) the paths become more predictable and you have to actually face enemies instead of blindly shooting. See original Contra games for what I mean.

replies.author: Secret_Slide_1357
replies.body:
Yes that was originally the plan. Then I went for full analog directional, and finally went for full auto target.   
Auto-target can be toggled on/off but it really makes the game more difficult. I might add the "contra mode" as another option where it's the 8 directions like you mentioned for more difficulty for hardcore players, that's a great idea! 

The auto-target really make the game more enjoyable on mobile since controlling both thumbs on the screen was not optimal gameplay imo.

Thanks for the feedback!
